1.w: Listen, children, to a father’s instruction, and pay attention so that you may gain discernment.

2.w: Because I hereby give you good instruction, do not forsake my teaching.

3.w: When I was a son to my father, a tender, only child before my mother,

4.w: he taught me, and he said to me: “Let your heart lay hold of my words; keep my commands so that you will live.

5.w: Acquire wisdom, acquire understanding; do not forget and do not turn aside from the words I speak.

6.w: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will guard you.

7.w: Wisdom is supreme —so acquire wisdom, and whatever you acquire, acquire understanding!

8.w: Esteem her highly and she will exalt you; she will honor you if you embrace her.

9.w: She will place a fair garland on your head; she will bestow a beautiful crown on you.”

10.w: Listen, my child, and accept my words so that the years of your life will be many.

11.w: I hereby guide you in the way of wisdom, and I lead you in upright paths.

12.w: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered, and when you run, you will not stumble.

13.w: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; protect it, because it is your life.

14.w: Do not enter the path of the wicked or walk in the way of those who are evil.

15.w: Avoid it, do not go on it; turn away from it, and go on.

16.w: For they cannot sleep unless they cause harm; they are robbed of sleep until they make someone stumble.

17.w: Indeed they have eaten bread gained from wickedness and drink wine obtained from violence.

18.w: But the path of the righteous is like the bright morning light, growing brighter and brighter until full day.

19.w: The way of the wicked is like gloomy darkness; they do not know what they stumble over.

20.w: My child, pay attention to my words; listen attentively to my sayings.

21.w: Do not let them depart from your sight; guard them within your heart,

22.w: for they are life to those who find them and healing to one’s entire body.

23.w: Guard your heart with all vigilance, for from it are the sources of life.

24.w: Remove perverse speech from your mouth; keep devious talk far from your lips.

25.w: Let your eyes look directly in front of you, and let your gaze look straight before you.

26.w: Make the path for your feet level, so that all your ways may be established.

27.w: Do not turn to the right or to the left; turn yourself away from evil.
